receipt: Atlas C now emits execution-ready code-change handoffs rather than only candidate descriptions. A zero-spend end-to-end probe materialized two distinct repairs for the same real authority-boundary defect, handed each to a D-shaped executor as explicit allowlisted write operations with exact base/content digests, replayed deterministically, and rolled both back without mutating the source tree. Code-change evidence was also made evidence-only: C no longer selects or promotes a winner.
